title: Letters and sounds
summary: Read and spell the 30 letters of the Turkmen alphabet, tell *y* from *ý* and *e* from *ä*, and greet people, give your name and say goodbye.
canDo: Read any Turkmen word aloud, letter by letter
Spell the letters an English speaker has to learn: ä, ç, ž, ň, ş, w, y and ý
Greet someone, ask how they are and say thank you
Give your name and ask someone else's
